manifest.authorizationReference: Owner approval 2026-10-18 for one hosted CPU pilot after cost unit 4, 64 warm-up and 32 measured frames, no added load. KhaozEngine issue 1418.

session.camera: IsoCamera3D.Frame(center <0, 0, 0>, size <2.5, 1, 1>), near 0.1, frustum culling on
session.light: directional <0.3, -0.4, -1> with cascaded shadow maps, one dynamic shadowed point light radius 3 at <0, 0, 2> near actor 0, target outlines on every actor, temporal resolve forced
session.layout: 1 actors on a 1-column grid at 3 x 1.5 world units, each a 50 x 20 cell host at spacing 0.05, poses alternate lifted and bent each frame, 1280 x 720 display target
session.timing: Stopwatch ticks, Scene3D.EnableTiming on, coverage stage, resolution and surface observers installed, no GPU

spans.name: warmup.frame.wall
spans.includes: completed warm-up frame wall times, kept as sizing evidence

spans.name: prepare.total
spans.includes: uncovered equipment draw writing per actor, the off-route counterpart of public preparation

spans.name: prepare.skinning
spans.includes: covered source vertex skinning inside staging

spans.name: prepare.geometryEvaluation
spans.includes: staged candidate construction: frames, interpolation, construction, core correction and normals, with no certification, which runs once in encode.renderCertification

spans.name: prepare.other
spans.includes: prepare.total less skinning and geometry evaluation

spans.name: submission
spans.includes: queueing host, equipment and outline draws, with coverage draw validation

spans.name: reserve
spans.includes: Scene3D.PrepareFrame resource reservation

spans.name: encode.total
spans.includes: Scene3D.RenderInternal into a null command list on the recording device, not a native backend encode

spans.name: encode.resolution
spans.includes: PrepareCoverageRendering: pass capture, spheres and render certification

spans.name: encode.renderCertification
spans.includes: CoverageCertification.Validate per complete preparation

spans.name: encode.resolutionOther
spans.includes: resolution less render certification

spans.name: encode.skinnedPreparation
spans.includes: the whole PrepareSkinnedDraws: surface append, ordinary skinning, coverage motion recording and skinned upload

spans.name: encode.surfaceAppend
spans.includes: AppendCoverageSurfaces, a child of encode.skinnedPreparation, informational

spans.name: encode.ordinarySkinning
spans.includes: the uncovered skinned draw loop, CPU vertex skinning on the CPU route or draw records on the GPU route, a child of encode.skinnedPreparation, informational

spans.name: encode.skinnedUpload
spans.includes: PrepareGpuSkinnedFrame and UploadCpuSkinnedFrame, a child of encode.skinnedPreparation, informational

spans.name: encode.skinnedPreparationOther
spans.includes: encode.skinnedPreparation less its three timed children: stream setup and coverage motion recording

spans.name: encode.motionCommit
spans.includes: the whole CompleteCoverageEncoding at the end of the render

spans.name: encode.other
spans.includes: encode.total less resolution, the skinned preparation and the motion commit

spans.includes: Scene3DPassTimingsMs CPU encode, not GPU time
